authorization: Second of at most two authorized subscription windows; no paid overage or API billing.
prerequisite: Actual three-turn persistent-worker smoke must attest one native session, physical request accounting and completed cleanup before the persistent coding treatment starts.
global_concurrency: Start balanced native/product and session pairs with a shared peak of 12 coding workers. Run normalized workers after those finish or as capacity permits without exceeding that peak. Independent source reviews use remaining capacity.
comparison_rules: Do not combine native and normalized tracks into one rank.
Treat protocol and request-budget failures as outcomes even when their patches pass.
Keep provider-capacity and infrastructure failures visible; an offline correct artifact does not repair trial eligibility.
Compare session enabled/disabled on identical source, tasks, prompts and response mode; context rewrites may legitimately reset native sessions.
Cache counters and API-equivalent token valuation are not actual subscription billing.
Any source repair or extra experiment after observing second-window results gets its own source pin and cohort. Preserve the original attempts.
additional_work: Use remaining subscription capacity for independent Claude Code reviews and real Collie workflow checks driven by confirmed findings. Label additional comparisons exploratory rather than altering these planned cohorts.
